title: A clinical study of treatments for non-small cell lung cancer (MK-3475-01H)
official: KEYMAKER-U01 Substudy 01H: A Phase 2, Randomized, Umbrella Study With Rolling Arms of Investigational Agents in Participants with Previously Treated Stage IV Nonsquamous Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
summary:
Main objective: 1.	To evaluate the objective response (OR) per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 as assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR).
2.	To evaluate the safety and tolerability of investigational treatments when used as monotherapy
conditions: Lung cancer non-small cell stage IV
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Stage IV non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
2. Participant/participants of childbearing potential (POCBP) is not pregnant and has a negative highly sensitive pregnancy test; and is not breastfeeding and uses a highly effective contraceptive method
3. Archival tumor tissue sample of a tumor lesion not previously irradiated has been provided
4. Has provided tissue prior to treatment randomization from a newly obtained formalin-fixed sample from a new biopsy
5. Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)-infected participants must have well controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy (ART)
6. Participants who are hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive have received hepatitis B virus (HBV) antiviral therapy for at least 4 weeks and have undetectable HBV viral load prior to randomization
7. Participants with history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection are eligible if HCV viral load is undetectable at screening
8. Documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 after receiving an anti-programmed cell death 1 protein (PD-1)/programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) treatment and platinum-based chemotherapy
9. Confirmation per local test report that epidermal growth factor receptor negative (EGFR-), anaplastic lymphoma kinase negative (ALK-), c ros oncogene 1 negative (ROS1-), or other directed therapy is not indicated as primary therapy
10. Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by investigator and verified by BICR
11. Life expectancy of at least 3 months
12. An Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1 assessed within 7 days before randomization
13. Is an individual of any sex/gender who is at least 18 years of age at the time of providing the informed consent
14. Has adequate organ function
15. If capable of producing sperm refrains from donating sperm plus either abstains from penile-vaginal intercourse or uses a penile/external condom, with contraceptive use consistent with local regulations
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of small cell lung cancer or, for mixed tumors, presence of small cell elements
2. Has received a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days before the first dose of study intervention
3. Has diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy
4. Has previously received docetaxel as monotherapy or in combination with other therapies
5. Has received an investigational agent or has used an investigational device within 4 weeks prior to study intervention administration
6. Has known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years
7. Has known untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
8. Has evidence of any leptomeningeal disease
9. Has history of interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis, current diagnosis of ILD, and/or suspected ILD
10. Has active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years
11. Has active infection requiring systemic therapy
12. Received radiation therapy to the lung
13. HIV-infected participants with a history of Kaposi’s sarcoma and/or Multicentric Castleman’s Disease
14. Has active inflammatory bowel disease requiring immunosuppressive medication or previous clear history of inflammatory bowel disease
15. Has known history of, or active, neurologic paraneoplastic syndrome
16. Has history of allogeneic tissue/solid organ transplant
17. Have not adequately recovered from major surgery or have ongoing surgical complications
18. Has uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disorder prior to randomization
19. Has clinically severe pulmonary compromise resulting from intercurrent pulmonary illnesses
20. Participants who have adverse events (AEs) (other than alopecia) due to previous anticancer therapies must have recovered to ≤Grade 1 or baseline
21. Has known severe hypersensitivity (≥Grade 3) to study intervention and/or any of its excipients
22. Has clinically significant corneal disease
23. Has received prior radiotherapy within 2 weeks of start of study intervention, or radiation related toxicities, requiring corticosteroids
24. Has inadequate washout period prior to randomization
